fact: The health minister launched Egypt's National Digital Health Strategy 2025–2029 at the PHDC'25 conference of 12 to 15 November 2025; it makes the Ministry of Health and Population the main regulator of the digital health system and aims by 2029 at secure, interoperable systems and health data unified at national level for decision-makers. The report names no HMIS or patient-record system and gives no budget.
title: وزير الصحة يطلق الإستراتيجية الوطنية للصحة الرقمية "2025–2029"
